result.summary: Independent frozen-manifest audit of Build R5 (observability and controlled comparisons) over 8920ffac→cc010ccd. The implementation matches the approved R5 requirements: R5.1 $writes unwrapping with a non-mutation regression against the real LangGraph producer; R5.2 allowlisted agent/exception-class diagnostics with secrets still redacted; R5.3 unconditional per-node transcript pointers plus persisted past_context/memory_note; R5.4 failed-attempt usage receipts with run-ID dedup and an explicit graph_only metrics boundary (the plan's permitted labeling alternative); R5.5 default-off private 0600 stage traces with ordered sequences, incomplete marking, env-secret redaction, and bounded requested/actual model provenance available without full tracing; R5.6 hash-verified source replay bound to ticker/clock/settings/stage/arguments/occurrence, typed-failure replay without raw diagnostics, re-executed search Command updates with current call IDs, explicit replay_miss/mixed-input taxonomy, tamper/symlink/overlap-rejecting pre-baseline snapshots with isolated writable clones, replay-disabled checkpointing, and rejection of resumed traces as baselines. All plan-named tests for R5.1–R5.6 are present; the native CLI pair proof shows one replay hit, zero misses, 12/12 model callbacks, equal starting snapshots, and unchanged baseline stores. Verdicts: merge integrity consistent; local R5 feature acceptance supported with disclosed fixture-only provider evidence; full-suite health green only per the builder receipt at 5b01bc1f; remote CI unverified (local unpushed branch, correctly not claimed). No critical or high finding. Six non-blocking findings: the four-role agent allowlist leaves other structured agents' fallback logs stage-anonymous; baseline live-store isolation is procedural (disclosed, needs a user decision); nonfinite floats in traced events poison a baseline; non-typed provider failures always force mixed-input; Timestamp type identity is not exactly preserved; and the suite receipt is one docs-only commit behind HEAD with tree equality builder-asserted.
limitations: Frozen-evidence-only audit: no test execution, runtime verification, network, or repository access beyond the supplied request.json; all pytest/Ruff/native-drill results are builder-supplied receipts, not independently rerun.

Production structured-output callers (tradingagents/agents/audit_pass.py, research_manager.py, trader.py, analyst agents) were not in the packet; the reachable set of agent names outside the run-logging allowlist is unverified, so finding 1 is partially confirmed.

The concatenated requirements context has no filename headers; file boundaries were inferred from content, and some unchanged neighboring source (e.g., cli/selections.py, graph/checkpointer.py, reporting.render_token_usage body) was absent or only partially inspectable.

Live-provider behavior is unproven by design at this stage: model callbacks, usage receipts on error, and Yahoo metadata shapes were exercised with fixtures (FakeListChatModel, OfflineModel, synthetic sources); on_llm_error delivering a response kwarg from real providers is unverified.
Remote CI, staging integration, Phase 1 live-provider baselines, and Na/Nb comparison runs are unperformed approved later stages and were not evaluated.
Full-suite receipt excludes 10 skipped tests (optional Bedrock SDK, private DOCN corpus/valuation/transcript fixtures) and 1 deselected integration marker, as disclosed.

Scratch-file extraction of the diff/requirements was blocked by the sandbox; analysis proceeded via windowed jq reads of the frozen JSON, which is slower but complete for the 4,483-line diff and the plan/report/test sections inspected.

findings.title: Run-log agent allowlist names only four roles; other structured agents' fallback warnings omit the stage (SE4 partial)
Baseline-run store isolation is procedural: trace-on recording against live stores still writes to them; only the candidate clone is automated (disclosed design decision — requires user decision)
Trace writer uses allow_nan=False without the source codec for tool/model events; one nonfinite float marks the entire attempt incomplete and unusable as a comparison baseline

Provider exceptions outside the three typed vendor errors are permanently unreplayable; recurring no-data errors (e.g., YFPricesMissingError on settlement zero-coverage) force mixed-input comparisons for affected runs
pandas.Timestamp payload values round-trip as stdlib datetime; value-equal but exact type identity not preserved as the producer-type commit implies
Full-suite and native-drill receipts bind to candidate 5b01bc1f, one commit behind audited HEAD cc010ccd; code-tree equality is builder-asserted and not verifiable from the frozen packet
